title: tests: 56.5% of spec files are per-issue pins costing 52.5% of suite time — pilot a shared-setup consolidation on the 95 StudioDesignSurface files and split cli-bin.test.ts (74.6 s)
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-24, verbatim: 「同意：建议新建：与合并无关、独立成卡的产品/契约项（可现在建）」, approving the review's list of independent product / contract cards. Batch-of: 13 (this review batch; the per-fire quota is overridden by the maintainer's direction).

## 维护者速读

5,773 个 spec 文件里 3,263 个（56.5 %）是 `-NNNN` 议题 pin，占实测套件时间 19,542 s 的 52.5 %；每文件固定开销主导（中位 4.49 s）。`ListView*` 112 个文件、`StudioDesignSurface*` 95 个、`ObjectView*` 76 个。最重的单文件 `StudioDesignSurface.autosaveSwitch-11232.test.tsx` 76.6 s、`cli-bin.test.ts` 74.6 s、`date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` 54 s。不横扫；用 `StudioDesignSurface.*` 做共享 render setup 的合并试点，并拆两个最重的 spawn 文件。先量 setup 与断言的占比再决定推广。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384; `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` measured 2026-10-12 plus the live spec list)

- Corpus: 5,773 spec entries, 49,302 tests, mean 8.5 / median 6 / p90 16 tests per file; 165 files with at most one test. 3,263 files match `-NNNN.test.`, summing 10,258 s of 19,542 s measured.
- Ratios: app-shell 1,715 test files vs 593 source files; plugin-list 159 vs 12; plugin-detail 301 vs 54; types 389 vs 85. Files per component: `ListView*` 112, `StudioDesignSurface*` 95, `ObjectView*` 76, `RecordDetailView*` 70, `ObjectGantt*` 52.
- Heaviest: `StudioDesignSurface.autosaveSwitch-11232.test.tsx` 76.6 s, `scripts/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts` 74.6 s, `date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` 54.0 s, `form-field-channel-effects-12130.test.tsx` 52.5 s. 79 test files spawn child processes (65 in `scripts/__tests__`), 442 s together.
- Static flake signals (no defect claimed): 0 `.only` / `.skip` / `.todo`, 0 vitest `retry`; but 1,014 raised RTL timeouts (`timeout: 8000` 474 times, 87 files in app-shell) and 26 files mixing `vi.useFakeTimers` with `waitFor`. Per AGENTS 测试纪律, an assertion behind a `React.lazy` boundary wants a module-scope import, not a timeout.
- Setup-versus-assertion share of the 4.49 s median is 未实测: extend `scripts/test-file-timings.mjs` with vitest's `collectDuration` / `setupDuration`.
- Business reason: every PR shard runs about 9 to 11 minutes and the full battery 5.4 h of compute (objectui#13448); per-file fixed cost is the lever the shard partition cannot touch.
- Dedup (`cli-bin.test|StudioDesignSurface.*test|consolidat … test|date-only-zone-pins`): 22 hits, 1 open (objectui#13349, shard timings — adjacent, not this); closed: objectui#12415 (moved two whole-repo costs out of one test), objectstack-ai/objectui#12405, objectstack-ai/objectui#3010, objectstack-ai/objectui#12208.

## Task

- [ ] Measure first: setup vs assertion time per file (instrument above); publish the reading in this card.
- [ ] Pilot: consolidate the 95 `StudioDesignSurface.*` files onto one shared render setup, keeping each issue number in its `describe`; report the before/after seconds.
- [ ] Split `cli-bin.test.ts` to share one built CLI (the Lint job already builds it) and collapse `date-only-zone-pins-10183` into one spawn with a zone matrix.
- [ ] Rule for new pins: a pin that needs the same setup as an existing `X.behaviour.test.tsx` joins that file.

Who acts: objectui `domain:ui` seat. Effort M (pilot) to L (if generalised). Risk: a merged file hides which pin broke — the `describe` names keep the issue numbers.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24, written through the maintainer's own account token (the session holds no fleet-bot credential). Evidence files: that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage grades and routes; suggested labels are suggestions only.
